Deutsches Technikmuseum, Berlin

LocationDeutsches Technikmuseum, Trebbiner Str. 9, 10963 Berlin, Germany
Visited9 September 2025
WebsiteDeutsches Technikmuseum

Museum Report

The Deutsches Technikmuseum is a large museum of science and technology in Berlin, The museum's original emphasis was on rail transport, but today it also features exhibits of various sorts of industrial technology - including a naval gallery.

Their collection includes a Biber midget submarine on loan from the Deutsches Museum, Munich, and a Fa 330 gyrocopter which was used from German U-boats during World War 2. Other naval artefacts on display include a chunk of armour from the World War 1 battle cruiser Seydlitz, and a life-ring from the battleship Baden.
